findings.suggestion: Add an end event to properly terminate the process.

findings.message: Element "t1" (serviceTask) has no outgoing sequence flows.
findings.suggestion: Connect this element to a downstream element or an end event.
Name start events using "Object + past participle", e.g. "Order Received", "Payment Initiated".
Name tasks using "Verb Object" form, e.g. "Verify Invoice", "Send Notification", "Approve Request".

findings.message: Start event "s" has no documentation describing expected input variables.
findings.suggestion: Add documentation listing the process input variables so callers know the expected contract.
Set isExecutable="true" — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a non-executable process.
Set a job type — Camunda 8 refuses to deploy a task with no task definition.

findings.message: Must contain at least one executable process
